description: Flux de collecte is published by ADEME. The table records collection-service flows by year, service and waste type. Its stated coverage is France; collection-service annual records. The schema gives survey years 2009 to 2025, with rows by collection service, department, region and waste type; gaps in single years were not checked because no data file was downloaded. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Licence Ouverte / Open Licence. Flow categories and units must be retained when constructing material balances. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
